info.title: Bells University of Technology API
info.description: Self-hosted OpenAPI documentation generated from registered Laravel routes. Authenticated endpoints use Laravel Sanctum bearer tokens obtained from `POST /api/login`.

tags.name: Academic
tags.description: Academic catalogue setup (campuses, programmes, courses, sessions, intakes, levels, O'level) and student academic self-service.

tags.name: Applications
tags.description: Admissions application pipeline. Staff list endpoints exclude applicants who are already matriculated with paid tuition (see Registrations).

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Authentication, session, profile, and two-factor flows.

tags.name: Candidate data
tags.description: JAMB candidate list upload and lookup used before applicant signup.

tags.name: Institution
tags.description: Campus structure, institution settings, and office hierarchy.

tags.name: Registrations
tags.description: Enrolled students who completed admission (matriculated) and have paid tuition. Filter by entry mode channel.

tags.name: Reports
tags.description: Gated custom reporting: allowlisted datasets, saved definitions, and tabular export.

get.description: Returns paginated applications for staff with `admissions.view`. Excludes records that qualify as registrations (matriculated with paid tuition invoice). Query filters: `stage`, `entry_mode`, `entry_modes` (comma-separated, e.g. `utme,de,transfer`).

parameters.name: entry_mode
parameters.description: Filter by a single entry mode (`utme`, `de`, `transfer`, `jupeb`, `pg`).

parameters.name: entry_modes
parameters.description: Comma-separated entry modes for channel views.

post.description: Import JAMB candidate rows from Excel/CSV. Requires `admissions.import`. Multipart fields: `file`, `academic_year`.

get.description: Public lookup used during applicant signup. Returns candidate row and suggested name/UTME prefill payload.

Returns paginated student records where the linked application is `matriculated` with a `student_id`, and the student has a paid `tuition` invoice. Requires `registrations.view`. Query filters: `entry_mode`, `entry_modes`.

parameters.name: entry_mode
parameters.description: Filter by a single entry mode.

bearerAuth.description: Send `Authorization: Bearer {token}` where the token is returned by `POST /api/login` or registration.
